cohort: Singleton children without congenital malformations, live-born at 22 to 37 weeks of gestation in Slovenia between 2002 and 2010.
finding: A low 5-minute Apgar score was associated with the combined outcome of neonatal death or cerebral palsy (CP) in all preterm births, and with CP alone in surviving preterm infants born at >32 weeks gestation.
